description: Send a request for quotation to SilkVin on behalf of a trade buyer (importer, distributor, wholesaler, parts store or workshop network). Lines can be OE numbers, catalogue line ids or free-text parts, with estimated quantities. Creates a case reviewed by a person; the written quote (price, Incoterm, lead time) follows by e-mail, normally within 48 working hours. Nothing is binding. It registers the buyer's contact details with SilkVin.

business_type.description: distributor/importer, reexporter, retailer (parts store or chain), workshop (network), other trade buyer
